page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is an x86_64 general purpose instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz, delivering 128 dedicated virtual cores. With 512.0 GB of total RAM, the instance maintains a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring the attachment of external block storage for operating system drives and persistent storage workloads. There are no onboard GPUs. Networking capabilities are anchored by a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating high-throughput data transfer requirements. It includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating as a large-scale resource profile, the instance enables efficient resource consolidation for organizations running dense container clusters or horizontally scalable applications on a single node. The trade-off of having no local NVMe storage requires careful consideration of network block storage performance, though the 64 Gbps baseline helps mitigate network latency. The instance is suited for high-traffic web serving, large-scale enterprise application backends, memory-balanced database nodes, and distributed computing.
